title: Strive Announces Bitcoin Buys & True North “Bitcoin for Business” Summit In Lake Oswego
summary: DALLAS, April 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Strive, Inc. (Nasdaq: ASST; SATA) (“Strive” or the “Company”) today announced the purchase of an additional ~789 Bitcoin, bringing its total holdings to ~14,557 Bitcoin. Additionally, Strive announced that True North, a research media sub-brand of Strive, is bringing its corporate Bitcoin curriculum to Oregon. The after-work summit takes place in Lake Oswego on May 21, 2026. It’s built for CFOs, founders, treasurers, and business owners who seek a working grasp of how Bitcoin is reshaping corporate finance. Publicly traded companies now hold more than 1.15 million BTC on their balance sheets, worth roughly $85 billion.
